Terraced garden retains steps, landing surfaces, palms and plantings. The sampled views show connected stair/terrace forms and a narrow focused region with progressive blur.
Two gold-toned divine figures on blue plinths are visible on the stepped temple forecourt. This is an interpretive fantasy arrangement.

Full-resolution view shows avenue, canal, timber bridge decks and bank approaches connected in the readable center. Low courtyard blocks extend toward the top and sides, becoming progressively blurred. The city reads as a miniature panorama.
